dependency_graph.assessment: The graph resolves the project (PyPI 0.2.0, requires-python >=3.6) and contains no runtime dependency edges and no reverse dependencies for it. This is consistent with the checkout: setup.py declares no install_requires and the sole native code is vendored zlib infback9 built by setuptools; setuptools, wheel and setuptools-scm are build-only requirements which the graph does not record (an omission, not a conflict). Absence of reverse-dependency edges is a graph limitation: upstream issues cite py7zr and TorchGeo as consumers, which the graph does not show.

data.summary: zipfile-deflate64 is a dormant (last commit and release 2022-01-05) single-maintainer pure-C setuptools extension. RISE already builds and publishes riscv64 wheels for 0.2.0 (PR #1105). Upstream has no riscv64 or aarch64 wheel, no RISC-V discussion, no CONTRIBUTING, and has ignored all packaging PRs since 2022, so an upstream patch is not a bounded, likely-to-land change. Recommendation: park.
